snippet.title: ScanIt! - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist ScanIt! on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2977680/ScanIt/

In ScanIt! you take on the role of a clerk working at a store, tasked with scanning items for each customer. The game introduces a unique gameplay mechanic that focuses on item manipulation, adding a layer of challenge and engagement and introducing a fresh twist to the simulation genre.

Available this fall!
